# Version 4.151.0
> **Performance and WASM improvements** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers a wave of managed-code performance wins and expands WASM support to .NET 11. This release focuses on eliminating unnecessary allocations and P/Invoke round-trips across color conversion, text shaping, and tag parsing. WASM gets Emscripten 5.0.6 libraries for .NET 11. Multiple upstream Skia m151 stability syncs and a CPU raster regression fix land too.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m151 and upstream stability fixes** — The baseline was updated to Skia m151, and four subsequent upstream cherry-pick syncs from the Skia chrome/m151 branch were applied. A CPU raster regression introduced by a shader-context change was also reverted. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4312](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4312), [#4382](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4382), [#4443](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4443), [#4489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4489), [#4428](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4428))

## API Surface

- **ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads for SKColor hex parsing** — SKColor.Parse, TryParse, and related methods now accept ReadOnlySpan<char> alongside string, enabling zero-allocation hex color parsing in hot paths. ([#4345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4345))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData fixed** — A native handle was not released when FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) failed or was given an out-of-bounds rectangle, leading to a silent native memory leak. ([#3997](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3997))
- **Unnecessary unsafe modifier removed from GRContextOptions** — GRContextOptions no longer carries an unsafe modifier that served no purpose, improving analyzer clean-ness for consumers referencing the type. ([#3991](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3991))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Widespread allocation and P/Invoke optimizations** — SKColor-to-SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply, SKFourByteTag parsing, HarfBuzzSharp.Tag parsing, HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8, SKShaper glyph reading, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms setup are all ported to managed math or zero-copy spans, eliminating per-call allocations and P/Invoke overhead. ([#4370](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4370), [#4385](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4385), [#4396](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4396), [#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4388](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4388), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11** — Pre-built Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries are now available for .NET 11 WASM targets. The new emsdk uses the exnref exception-handling model, and a preview WASM test leg validates exception-handling regressions. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459), [#4487](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4487), [#4488](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4488))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzz 14.2.1 ships with allocation-free AddUtf8(string) via pooled char arrays and removes per-call char[4] allocations in Tag.Parse, making text shaping pipelines significantly cheaper.

## Release Candidate 1 (July 21, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 added Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries for .NET 11, the exnref exception-handling build, the CPU raster regression revert, the SKImage resource leak fix, and the final round of upstream m151 syncs.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.2.1...v4.151.0-rc.1.1)

## Preview 2 (July 14, 2026)

Preview 2 delivered the bulk of the performance work: managed-code color conversion, zero-copy glyph result spans, allocation-free HarfBuzz tag parsing, and the SKColor ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, plus additional upstream m151 fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.0-preview.1.1...v4.151.0-preview.2.1)

## Preview 1 (July 2, 2026)

Preview 1 established the 4.151.0 baseline by updating Skia to milestone m151 and landing the first round of upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.150.1...v4.151.0-preview.1.1)
